svg.title: The canonical cerebellar circuit as a predictive module
svg.desc: Canonical mammalian cerebellar microcircuit drawn as one predictive module. Panel A: an oblique block of cortex with broad molecular stripes and a narrower microzone crossing the layers. Panel A-prime: one microzone enlarged, showing mossy fibres carrying estimated state, motor command and task context converging in glomeruli onto granule cells whose parallel fibres cross many Purkinje arbors, Golgi and molecular-layer interneurons, and a climbing fibre from the inferior olive on the smooth proximal dendrites. Panel B: the subcortical loop through the cerebellar nuclei, the direct Purkinje projection to the vestibular nuclei, the electrically coupled inferior olive, and nucleo-olivary feedback. Panel C: the amniote deep-nucleus output neuron contrasted with the teleost eurydendroid cell inside the ganglionic layer.
